title: QoL Recipes
description: This datapack adds useful recipes, like logs into sticks, dropper into dispenser, and more.
body: This datapack adds useful recipes to make your life easier, such as: Dropper to Dispenser, Bone to Bone Block, Logs to Chests and Sticks, Raw Mineral Blocks to their smelted versions and shapeless Shulker Box crafting.
